name: Intron
description: Intron is a speech-to-text API tuned for African accents. Its docs list 36 African input languages — several, such as Wolof, Swahili, Hausa and Yoruba, as models code-switched with English — with optional LLM post-processing of the transcript; it also offers streaming speech-to-text and text-to-speech.
example_prompt: Transcribe Wolof and Swahili voice notes sent by my users and summarize them with Intron.
